summary:
Shane Hollander has a reputation.
Polite. Controlled. The nicest guy in hockey. He's spent six years building it, and six years doing something that would burn it to the ground if anyone ever found out.
He's good at compartmentalising. He's good at a lot of things. Until he meets Rose Landry.
She's direct where he deflects, certain where he second-guesses, and completely uncomplicated in a way that should make everything easier. It doesn't. Because Shane already has a complication. A six-year absolutely-not-a-relationship Russian complication who has no intention of staying in his compartment.
Shane has always been good at keeping things separate. He's starting to think that's a lie.
---
aka a study in what if the post tuna meltdown happened to a bisexual Shane Hollander.
